span.label: mechanisms
span.term: In AN2 each spike triggers a slowly decaying afterhyperpolarizing current; during a stimulus these afterhyperpolarizations accumulate, progressively lowering excitability and thereby producing the adaptation.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: In AN2 the responsible conductance is inferred to be a spike-triggered AHP- or M-type current rather than a network effect.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: In BSN1 the hyperpolarization is not generated by the cell's own spikes but is imposed by presynaptic inhibitory input driving slow hyperpolarizing currents.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A functional design rule: when a neuron's computation depends on the balance of incoming excitation and inhibition, adaptation must sit in the neuron itself rather than in its inputs, so that the balance is preserved.

Q-467. · strength of the relation: 1 — THE WHOLE DESIGN IN ONE SENTENCE: sound convolves the cell's own adaptation with every process upstream of it; injected current does not. span.label: RETRACTED (A CONDITIONAL MODEL PREDICTION, AND THE CUE WAS A MATHEMATICAL PRODUCT) · receptor —causes→ adaptation ratio
span.note: RETRACTED: A CONDITIONAL MODEL PREDICTION, AND THE CUE WAS A MATHEMATICAL PRODUCT. The edge is `receptor --causes--> adaptation ratio`. The span reads 'Quotation withheld, the ratio ... SHOULD BE THE PRODUCT of the adaptation ratio of the interneuron and that of the receptor cells ... Thus, in the simplest case: r a ac = 0.5 x r a cu. Our data were compared with this relation.' Every clause is conditional or arithmetic: an expectation derived under an assumption, stated so it can be TESTED against data. The only EFFECT cue in it is `produc`, inside THE PRODUCT OF - multiplication, not causation. WHAT THE SPAN DOES SAY (Q-309): a predicted arithmetic relation under an explicit linearity assumption, which is not a causal claim by this paper and is nearer to a `holds_when` on someone else's model than to an edge. Nothing kept; the linearity assumption is the paper's foil, not its finding. — strength of the relation: 1 — THE ARITHMETIC NULL MODEL: if the mechanisms compose linearly the ratios multiply, and receptors adapt to ~50%, so the prediction is a LINE on the figure, not a direction

span.label: Three identified interneurons of the locust auditory pathway show three qualitatively different distributions of adaptation mechanisms: mixed intrinsic/presynaptic in TN1, inhibition-driven in BSN1, and intrinsic spike-triggered in AN2.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The time course of adaptation is cell-type specific, differing significantly between the three neuron types.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Spike frequency adaptation is not confined to one station but operates at every level of the sensory pathway.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The measured adaptation time constants successfully predicted each cell's high-pass cutoff frequency for amplitude-modulated signals.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: All three interneurons behave as bandpass filters, with the low-pass edge set by mean firing rate and the high-pass edge by adaptation.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Which adaptation mechanism a neuron uses tracks the computation it performs, so the origin of adaptation is a function of the cell's processing role.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: three distinct distributions of adaptation mechanisms emerged across three cell types of one pathway
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AN ARITHMETIC NULL MODEL, NOT A DIRECTION: linear composition predicts the acoustic ratio equals 0.5 times the current ratio, and the data were compared against that line
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: in TN1 the magnitude of SFA to acoustic stimuli was qualitatively in agreement with a linear combination of SFA in receptors and adaptation mechanisms within TN1
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A PREDICTED CORRELATION THAT FAILED: cells adapting more under current should adapt more under sound, and TN1 showed r = 0.09, p = 0.81

span.label: BSN1 at 140 Hz adapted far more than the null model allows, implying processes the model does not contain
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AN ANALYSIS DECLINED AND SAID SO: AN2 was not analysed at the higher onset response because only one cell reached it under both modes
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: time constants were similar across modes in TN1 and in AN2, and differed in BSN1 where sound gave 18.7 ms against 49.8 ms for current
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: TN1 and BSN1 showed very similar adaptation characteristics under current stimulation, this pattern changed dramatically in BSN1 under acoustic stimulation, and in AN2 the two modes gave very similar results
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE TWO-SOURCE LOGIC: an intrinsic current would hyperpolarise after either stimulus, but only sound lets another neuron inhibit the cell
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: in BSN1 hyperpolarisation tracked acoustic response strength at r = -0.93 and current stimulation had no effect at all

span.label: in AN2 hyperpolarisation tracked response strength under both modes, around r = -0.92
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: CONFOUND NAMED: an absent hyperpolarisation could mean the electrode was far from the spike initiating zone rather than that no current exists

span.label: CONFOUND ANSWERED BY CHANGING THE OBSERVABLE: spontaneous spike counts were used instead, since the recording site cannot affect them

span.label: the spike-count control gave the same answer, and the two analyses agree
